headline: Obama, 2009: The high *cost* of economic *inaction*
quote: The cost of inaction will be far greater.
title: Obama, 2009: What is the true cost of economic inaction?
caption: During the 2009 financial crisis, Obama warned Congress against delaying bold measures. He argued that inaction would lead to a prolonged economic slump.
comment: Was the scale of the 2009 recovery plan sufficient?
